createOrReplace.title: Undergraduate Admissions - Khalifa University
createOrReplace.excerpt: UAE General Secondary School and Applied Technology: Mathematics mandatory, along with one science subject (Physics, Biology, or Chemistry); minimum score of 80% for the Advanced and Elite streams, or 90% for the General stream, in the above-mentioned subjects. American High School Diploma, SABIS, Indian (CBSE) and Pakistani Boards: Mathematics mandatory, along with one science subject; minimum of 80% in the final grade (Grade 12) in the above-mentioned subjects. British (IGCSE, GCSE, GCE): a total of 8 subjects; minimum five IGCSE/GCSE (O-Level) subjects with grade C or above; 3 AS Level or 3 A Level subjects (or a combination, minimum 3) may be considered; Mathematics (Mandatory) (minimum Grade C); two of Physics, Chemistry, and/or Biology (minimum Grade C). IB: full IB Diploma with six HL/SL subjects; minimum score of 4 in each subject, total of 24 points; Mathematics mandatory along with one science subject. Mandatory English: IELTS Academic 6.0 OR TOEFL iBT 79. Preferable (strengthens application): Math SAT 700; AP Calculus/Physics C/Chemistry/Biology 3. Program table: Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering etc. X X; Computer Science* O O O (one of the science subjects). Shortlisted applicants will be required to take KU Admission Tests (KUAT). Admission is competitive; meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee final admission.
